attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Elias stood by the cot, the thin blanket draped over Constance.","reason":"The caravan was lost in the blizzard; nothing says her body was recovered and brought home."},{"span":"He remembered her iron will, the way she faced the blizzard.","reason":"Nothing says Elias was with the caravan or witnessed the blizzard."}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The scene puts Constance's body on a cot at home, though the briefing says she was lost with the caravan in the blizzard, and it has Elias remembering a blizzard he apparently didn't witness. The letter is 'tucked into her bedside drawer' yet 'heavy in his palm', which muddles the image, but the plain closing resolve works."}
